summary.en: Feeling suspicious, Conan discusses the cases along with Haibara, the Detective Boys, and Takagi. Meanwhile in the lecture, Mei Tsukuba reveals that she was the one to invite him, and has him deduce about a case that was abandoned by Eri Kisaki. Conan investigates and finds out that the newspaper clips were pointing to a case of murder that happened a year ago when a professor's assistant stabbed his master for stealing his research works.
